premises.text: Busy professionals need household chores handled but do not want the time and mental energy of coordinating multiple on-demand services
premises.evidence_span: all of that takes time and coordination and the mental energy. Dan doesn't want to give it

premises.text: For a monthly fee, Alfred visits weekly on set days as a service layer that coordinates on-demand and local providers with a real person
premises.evidence_span: For $99 a month, Dan can get his very own Alfred that visits once a week, every week, on set days to take care of his household chores

premises.text: Alfred anticipates needs and works in the background across verticals so customers set automatic preferences instead of making requests
premises.evidence_span: Alfred anticipates that Dan will need to press that on-demand button and works and acts in the background, coordinating across multiple verticals

premises.text: Neighborhood-dedicated Alfreds are background-, credit-, and reference-checked and assigned via clustering and scheduling
premises.evidence_span: Alfreds are background, credit, and reference checked, and that each neighborhood has its own dedicated Alfreds

premises.text: Weekly set-day visits group chores across neighbors for economies of scale passed to customers
premises.evidence_span: they visit you and your neighbors every week on set days, so they group chores, which gives us economies of scale that we can pass along to you

premises.text: Building partnerships turn on neighborhoods overnight and make the model scalable
premises.evidence_span: we partner with buildings, which allows us to turn on neighborhoods overnight, making us scalable

value.text: Give busy people back their time through seamless automatic household service
value.evidence_span: give you back the most precious resource you have, your time

secondary_value.text: Well-paid proud work for vetted community Alfreds helping neighbors
secondary_value.evidence_span: Alfreds are vetted members of your community who enjoy well-paid work that they are proud of helping their neighbors
